cpdLivesAndVoicesQuotes.approvedDirection: Sample 1: alternating unfilled dotted-green speech bubbles
cpdLivesAndVoicesQuotes.scope: Lives and Voices quotation figure only; preserve other quotation and global design rules.
cpdLivesAndVoicesQuotes.content: Retain all seven verbatim quotations, names and source text in their original DOM order.
cpdLivesAndVoicesQuotes.alignment: Alternate left/right; place each attribution below its own quotation, aligned to the same side.
cpdLivesAndVoicesQuotes.appearance: 2px dotted course-green border, 15px corners and small side tails matching the page surface, with no contrasting fill.
cpdLivesAndVoicesQuotes.behavior: Responsive CSS decoration; no JavaScript required.

cpdPeople.scope: People page only; inherit the existing course theme, typography, content width and sidebar without changing the global design system.
cpdPeople.structure: Unboxed semantic team list; working-group names and collaborating organisations use simple semantic lists. Preserve all original copy.

teamLayout.phonePortrait: 88px square alongside the person's details at 420px and below

replacementPortrait.treatment: Resize the complete source image; apply square display cropping only in CSS.

cpdLanding.approvedDirection: Sample 2: Place first, without the middle dark-green weekly navigation strip
cpdLanding.scope: Course landing page only; preserve the global identity and existing lesson shell guidance.
cpdLanding.typography: Inherit Manrope headings and Nunito Sans body text.
cpdLanding.palette: Inherit paper, deepGreen and actionGreen from the global colors.

hero.desktop: Image-led hero with a cream inset introduction and green start-course button.
hero.mobile: Stack image, cream introduction, then course contents.

courseOutline.structure: Native details and summary disclosures with fine dividers, week numbers, titles, short summaries and plus/minus indicators.
courseOutline.expandedContent: Start-week link and grouped lesson links; two columns on desktop, one on mobile.
courseOutline.navigation: Introductory and supporting resource links accompany the outline; no separate dark-green weekly navigation strip.
courseOutline.accessibility: Preserve keyboard focus, native disclosure behavior without JavaScript and reduced-motion support.
